name: Sql Queries
tagline: Adds SQL query/report capabilities to the VirtoCommerce platform, enabling advanced data access directly through SQL.

git.lastCommit: 5359716 2026-07-15 ci: Auto update Github Action workflows

readme.overview: This module is designed to empower administrators and developers by providing a secure and flexible way to perform direct database queries within the VirtoCommerce environment. It integrates seamlessly with the platform and supports a variety of query types, enhancing the ability to retrieve, analyze, and manage business data without external tools.
keyFeatures: Execute custom SQL queries against the VirtoCommerce databases.
Integrate with the platform’s security and permissions system to control query access.
Return results in user-friendly formats for reporting and analysis: HTML, PDF, CSV, XLSX.
Supports query parameters: Short Text, Date Time, Boolean, Integer, Decimal.
Supports multiple database providers: SQL Server (default), MySQL, and PostgreSQL.

notes.forAnalyst: Saved SQL queries an administrator can run and export — reporting without a BI project.
notes.forArchitect: Two entities and six migrations, no dependencies, five permissions. Powerful and deliberately permissioned: it puts SQL in the back office, which is exactly as dangerous as it sounds.
notes.forDeveloper: Two declared events. Treat the permission as production-critical, use read-only credentials where possible, and remember queries bypass every module's caching and validation.
reachForItWhen: An ad-hoc question needs answering from data today
Reporting is not worth a BI pipeline yet
Support needs a repeatable diagnostic query
doNotReachForItWhen: Untrusted users could reach it — this is direct database access
The query belongs in an application feature: build the feature
The data lives across modules that own their own schemas: joins here couple you to them
